highlights: UGREEN 12000mAh Car Battery Jump Starter Zero Voltage Switch 1000A UltraSafe Powerbank Emergency Power Supply with LED Light

Jump starts a dead battery in seconds, up to 20 jump starts on a single charge. This jump starter's powerful 1000A peak current quickly starts low-voltage and fully-drained batteries.
